headline: Mint/burn nets now wait for complete classification, and supply gap-fills need a reviewed on-chain pair.
fieldNotes: A roster-wide check against archive supply found four coins publishing materially wrong mint/burn nets. DAI showed +$19.2B over 30 days while its supply fell. Eleven releases withheld those nets, fixed the bridge and internal-burn classification behind them and added a daily reconciliation against on-chain supply. Supply work applied the same test to provider data: refused gap-fills removed USDf's $163.6M double count, and GHO's redefinition was accepted with its earlier anchors withheld.

summary.label: Mint/burn 6.46
summary.description: Eleven releases, 6.36 to 6.46. Bridge and internal-burn fixes replace the holds on four coins' wrong nets, daily receipts reconcile the ledger with on-chain supply, and /flows/ shows a labelled subset net instead of NR.

summary.label: Pricing 6.83
summary.description: Eight releases, 6.76 to 6.83. Supply gap-fills need a reviewed on-chain pair, ending USDf's $163.6M double count. GHO publishes about $268M after a reviewed provider redefinition, and 15 more coins gain dropout guards.

summary.label: Liquidity Score 7.3
summary.description: Three releases, 7.1 to 7.3. Curve metapools count their base-pool LP leg, and balance health no longer penalises a pool for holding less of the tracked coin than its target. The DEX card shows LUSD/3CRV's unmovable LP.

summary.label: Safety Score 10.44
summary.description: Negligible DEX observations no longer replace unknown Exit pricing. Backing curation settles three gaps from primary evidence, and 28 AI summaries drop pillar rankings that the live cards contradicted.

summary.label: Depeg detection 6.46
summary.description: Two releases, 6.45 and 6.46. A proven outflow on an isolated canonical leg can raise DEWS stress but never lower it, and a lone Mento Broker quote can no longer lift a coin's DEWS band above WATCH.

summary.label: Status verdicts
summary.description: The status page and operator light colour only confirmed, material problems, and unreadable evidence holds a component's last confirmed state. Indexed reads and an hourly-capped reliability rollup relieve D1 overload.

summary.label: Search and page speed
summary.description: Closed low-confidence depeg events become indexable, FreezeWatch checks an address from its hero and releases ping IndexNow. Safety Scores and Portfolio deliver their main content earlier, without waiting for JavaScript.

summary.label: Catalog and sources
summary.description: BUIDL supply reads on-chain across ten deployments after DefiLlama stopped updating it, and IDRT's on-chain stock becomes primary. DLLR and XUSD stay active with redemption routes suspended after the Sovryn halt.

summary.label: Codebase untangle
summary.description: Clean-up runs cut import cycles, removed the shared types barrel, grouped components into per-domain folders and generated the Worker cron arrays from the schedule table, while 89 tests switched to asserting outcomes.
